purpose: Freeze the post-WF1-A evidential signature before inspection or analysis of the external parquet population.
primary_reference_reason: S2-B removes every seed touched by persistent missingness and therefore contains a completely balanced zero-missing retained main dataset.
preserved_negative_or_mixed_findings: PRESERVATION was mixed / not robustly replicated.
interpretation_boundary: Does not establish literal internal neural topology.
External population rarity must be measured independently.
external_population_rule: No parquet corpus may be used to choose or modify the WF1-A source signature.
Only features computable passively from both RSOS reference material and external conversations may enter the population benchmark.
Any passive projection from WF1-A/F1/F2 into parquet-computable coordinates must be frozen before scoring the external population.
No threshold may be selected after observing external-population scores.
No external match may be silently removed.
Negative and near-match external examples must be preserved.
